reviews.review:
The font is completely illegible. Change it back to a normal font, please. It's all garbled and I can't understand anything at all. I'm so frustrated!!!

This font is extremely detrimental to the gameplay. Not to mention the illegible and ugly appearance, the key point is that the Chinese language is all garbled. It's normal for a sentence to have only one or two characters, but 80% of the characters are garbled, making it completely impossible to understand what the text is. The developers don't even need to take a look. I'm the first one to support your game. I really want to support you, but I can't even understand the text

If the production team can solve the font issue and switch to a normal font, I will change the rating to "Recommended" and continue to support it.
